# Keep the Light 1.39.0

- **TVmaze now helps when TMDB has nothing.** A show (or an episode) TMDB doesn't have is looked up on TVmaze, and the searches list TVmaze's shows after TMDB's, marked "TVmaze". The Plex names tab shows what TVmaze said about each season.
- **Audio tracks that are already compatible are copied, not converted again.** When your rules convert audio, an AC-3, E-AC-3 or AAC track that already fits is kept as it is (marked "already compatible"). A new rule turns this off if you want the old way.
- **Keep the best track and a compatible one:** with "Add a compatible audio track when needed", the file's own E-AC-3 (or AC-3, AAC) track is kept beside a TrueHD Atmos one, instead of a new copy being made.
